claude.result:
I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

**Core Functionality:**
- **`src/cycles.js`**: Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` and configured it to calculate monthly costs as (price × 52) / 12, rounded to the nearest cent. Updated `nextCharge()` to handle 7-day charging intervals for weekly plans.

- **`bin/subtrack.js`**: Added 'week'/'weekly' to the command-line parser, updated the usage text, and fixed error messages to include the new option.

- **`src/renewals.js`**: Fixed a sorting bug where renewals were ordered by the short label string instead of actual dates, which was causing incorrect ordering.

- **`src/export.js`**: Added weekly cycle support to the CSV export calculation.

- **`test/cycles.test.js`**: Added comprehensive tests for weekly plan monthly costs and next-charge calculations.

## Feature Verification

The implementation works as specified:
- `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` → €259.56/month (€59.90 × 52 ÷ 12)
- Weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`
- `subtrack renewals` lists weekly plans alongside other subscription types
- All existing functionality (list, total, export) works correctly with weekly plans
- All 36 tests pass

The changes are ready to commit when you're ready.
